name: Camp Wildwood
description: Kids' summer camp template with a five-layer parallax forest-and-mountain hero, bouncy activity badges and weekly session cards.
features: Layered SVG landscape hero with tents, lake and campfire
Six stitched merit badges that pop in and bounce on hover
Six weekly session cards with ages, inclusions and prices
Day-at-camp timeline, sticky-note reviews and registration form
signature: Mountains, forests, lake and campsite layers move at different speeds on scroll; activity badges bounce like springs
